FROM user WHERE username = ?`) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88 (siblings: store/db/postgres/user.go, store/db/mysql/user.go) Back in the handler, the stored `user.AvatarURL` is a data URI held in the `user.avatar_url` column: `parseDataURI` (server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737) base64-decodes it, the MIME type is checked against `avatarAllowedTypes` (line 75), and the bytes are written with `c.Blob` (line 209).
